# Group API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

A set of users, such as a lab or a team, that can be given a role as one.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/users/group/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/users/group/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `group` (detail, create, update), `groups` (list)
- **Permissions:** see the [permissions page](/datamodel/permissions/)
- **Uniqueness:** `name` unique across BrainSTEM
- **Deleting:** also deletes the linked [`behavioralassaygroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/behavioralassaygroupmembershipinvitation/), [`datastoragegroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/datastoragegroupmembershipinvitation/), [`groupmembershipinvitation`](/api/users/groupmembershipinvitation/), [`groupmembershiprequest`](/api/users/groupmembershiprequest/), [`inventorygroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/inventorygroupmembershipinvitation/), [`laboratory`](/api/users/laboratory/), [`licensegroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/licensegroupmembershipinvitation/), [`projectgroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/stem/projectgroupmembershipinvitation/), [`protocolgroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/protocolgroupmembershipinvitation/), [`setupgroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/setupgroupmembershipinvitation/) records

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | number **[read-only]** |
| `name` | string **[required]**; max 150 characters |
| `users` | computed **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/users/group/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('group', load_all=True)
records = resp['groups']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('group', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.groups;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "groups": [
        {
            "id": 1,
            "name": "Group 1",
            "users": null
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/users/group/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('group', data={"name": "Group 1"})
record = resp.json()['group']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('name', 'Group 1'), 'group');
record = created.group;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/users/group/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('group', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['group']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('group', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.group;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "group": {
        "id": 1,
        "name": "Group 1",
        "users": null
    }
}
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/users/group/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('group', id='<id>', data={"name": "Group 1 (renamed)"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'name', 'Group 1 (renamed)'), 'group', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/users/group/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('group', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'group');
```

## Custom actions

| Action | Request |
|:-------|:--------|
| `join_group` | POST `/api/private/users/group/<id>/join/` |
| `leave_group` | POST `/api/private/users/group/<id>/leave/` |
{% endraw %}

## Usage notes

- `users` is read-only. Members join through a [group membership invitation](/api/users/groupmembershipinvitation/) sent by a manager, or through a [membership request](/api/users/groupmembershiprequest/) that a manager accepts.
